cja_panel.what: If the court finds a person eligible for appointed counsel, it appoints either the Federal Defender or a private CJA panel attorney. The Federal Defender page says it represents about 75% of financially eligible federal defendants in the district; the rest go to private panel attorneys. Panel training is run by the Federal Defender offices in Sacramento and Fresno.
